### [`compose_buffer_last`](../../../../src/graphics/compose_buffer_end.asm#L6) `$0800`

*variable*

Last byte of the fighter composition buffer $05ca-$0800 (63 rows of 9 bytes).
$8a1c clears it and $8a2c and $8a75 write it.
